item.text: Your browser saves copies of website files, such as images, stylesheets, and scripts, so pages load faster on future visits. Sometimes it keeps using those stored copies even after the site has been updated, making the website appear unchanged on your laptop. Try a hard refresh, clear the browser cache, or open the page in a private/incognito window. If the issue persists, the website’s server or content-delivery network may still be serving an older version.
